title: Make API typecheck self-sufficient in clean CI workspaces
authorization: Bounded root-cause repair of the public CI workflow explicitly authorized by Mamdouh; no feature scope expansion.
root_cause: Hosted run 30396487436 and an independent fresh-clone reproduction both fail at apps/api typecheck because PrismaClient is generated in an existing local node_modules but absent after pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Prisma generate itself succeeds without DATABASE_URL and does not connect to a database.
forbidden: No Git/GitHub command, commit, push, Docker, integration test, database connection, deployment, or release.
requirements: Change only @estateflow/api typecheck script so it runs its existing db:generate script before tsc --noEmit.
Do not alter db:generate itself or any command contracts outside the typecheck precondition.
Record RED clean-clone typecheck symptom and GREEN proof that prisma generation succeeds without DATABASE_URL and typecheck can then see PrismaClient.
acceptance: apps/api typecheck is self-sufficient after a fresh frozen install without database connectivity.
pnpm typecheck and existing local non-integration quality commands remain PASS.
No scope outside packet paths changes and worker evidence is present.
